Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium real estate service card illustration, transparent cutout, companion to highly detailed photorealistic isometric miniatures of a white apartment interior and an architectural valuation folder.
Primary request: a polished architect's scale model of a contemporary small commercial office building, not a residential house and not a skyscraper. Two to three floors, crisp white porcelain-like architectural facade, finely textured very light neutral-gray concrete, brushed silver metal frames, large clear glass windows. A carefully composed modest stepped volume with one lower wing. Through the windows show believable miniature office desks, chairs and glazed meeting-room partitions, giving the model real depth. Ground floor includes a clear glazed commercial entrance with a tiny canopy, elegant shallow front steps and a compact paved entrance zone with two restrained architectural planters. Include fine architectural details like mullions, door pulls, handrails and paving joints, not decorative random objects.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3 canvas, whole architectural model fully visible from a 3/4 elevated isometric angle, facade and side elevation both visible, compact sculptural mass centered and filling about 85% of the canvas with comfortable transparent margins on all sides, thin pale slab under the building only. Render intended to remain legible at 320 x 240 pixels while retaining exquisite micro-detail at full resolution. No cropped edges.
Lighting: clean soft daylight from upper left, luminous white highlights, natural dimensional shading and gentle contact shadow beneath the model. Keep glass clear and bright, with only a very subtle pale-blue reflection. No dark glass slab appearance.
Palette/materials: white porcelain, clean pale gray concrete, silver metal, neutral gray interior furniture. Tiny natural green plants are allowed. No beige, no cream, no warm timber, no orange or gold. The entire object must not have a blue tint, haze or color filter; whites remain white.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background, including around soft contact shadows. No backdrop, no colored panel, no horizon, no floor plane beyond the small building base, no baked checkerboard.
Avoid: text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, signage, people, cars, keys, icons, charts, floating badges, cartoon outlines, low-poly simplification. This should look like an expensive, carefully built photorealistic architectural miniature, with a calm premium real-estate aesthetic.
